name: blur-in
description: CSS filter:blur(N) → blur(0) wrapper. Adds a focus-pull aesthetic to entrance moments. Filter is the only non-compositor-friendly prop the engine animates by design — keep blur radii small (≤16px) to stay GPU-accelerated.

props.name: easing
props.description: Named easing or CSS easing string.

examples.title: Hero focus-pull
examples.description: Heading sharpens into focus on mount.

ai.whenToUse: Use for hero headings or feature reveals where you want a cinematic focus-pull. Distinct from FadeIn — adds depth without heavy motion.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use on small text (<14px) — the blur is illegible mid-animation. Don't use on lists; cumulative blur is GPU-heavy.
commonMistakes: Blur radii > 16px cause noticeable jank on lower-end GPUs.
Stacking BlurIn over FadeIn is redundant; keep `fade` enabled instead.
ai.accessibilityNotes: Reduced-motion collapses the blur, ensuring text is immediately legible.
